Jordan — thanks and apologies for the short turnaround; attached is our redline (CE_Amendment_Redline_20260603.docx). Summary of the principal changes we propose: 

- Capacity carve-out: we will add the 120k GPU-hours as a separate Exhibit (Exhibit D), and we classify 80% as Reserved Capacity and 20% as Elastic Burst. Elastic Burst is expressly limited to account-level soft caps; customer will not be billed for burst beyond agreed daily rate without prior notice.
- Fee smoothing: agreed in principle — we propose an explicit invoicing schedule (Jul: 40%, Aug: 35%, Sep: 25% of the incremental capacity fee) with a reconciliation clause at quarter end. Include clawback if actual usage is < 70% of amortized forecast; clawback limited to the incremental portion only.
- Implementation timeline: we updated to 45 days; added a milestone with a one-off credit of 5% of implementation fees if Redwood misses the agreed start date by >10 business days.
- Termination and refunds: added a short paragraph preserving existing MSA termination rights and clarifying refund mechanics for pre-paid capacity in a mid-quarter termination.
- Data/PD obligations: confirmed no new data processing obligations beyond existing MSA; added explicit statement to that effect.

Next steps for us: please confirm the PO date and whether CraftEdge accepts the reserved/burst split. If you accept, we'll prepare a final clean amendment and DocuSign routing for signature.
